author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
When using AI agents at work, you are compelled to work at weekends.  You don't have to spend a lot of time, you just need to log in once every 3-4 hours to kick your AI agents to make it work harder, or you will lose 48 hours of AI productivity in a week. 

AI agent still can't run reliable over a 8 hours stretch, that is the sweet spot for real productivity gain.  I lost at least 4 hours of AI productivity every night while I am sleeping.
